acceptance_checks.given: The desktop shell in light or dark appearance
acceptance_checks.when: Sidebar and main region are rendered
acceptance_checks.then: The desktop chrome presents one adaptive canvas without a contrasting shell seam
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Desktop light and dark screenshots plus computed background styles

acceptance_checks.when: Its outer main-region treatment is inspected
acceptance_checks.then: The main region has a continuous surface without a raised outer card
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Desktop screenshots and owning layout CSS review

acceptance_checks.given: The native macOS overlay or Reduce Transparency is active
acceptance_checks.when: The sidebar is shown beside working content
acceptance_checks.then: The shared desktop canvas remains uniform across the sidebar boundary
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Signed macOS screenshot and reduced-transparency browser check

acceptance_checks.given: Existing Today, Tasks, Notes, Calendar, Settings and Notifications routes
acceptance_checks.then: Working content retains readable hierarchy and interactive state
acceptance_checks.verify_method: All-route screenshot review and real navigation checks

acceptance_checks.when: The drawer is opened and its destinations are activated
acceptance_checks.then: Navigation controls remain reachable with visible focus and working dismissal
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Compact and large-text keyboard drawer checks

acceptance_checks.given: Increase Contrast or forced colors is active
acceptance_checks.when: The desktop shell and its interactive states are displayed
acceptance_checks.then: Readable labels and visible focus remain available on continuous desktop chrome
